Random Effect Model Specification

Source: R/auxiliary.R
re.Rd

Specifies the terms for a random effect model.

Usage

re(...)

Arguments

...

Variables representing the random effects in the model. Each variable adds its own independent random effect.

Value

A list of class RiskMap_re_spec containing the following elements:

term

A character vector of the specified terms.

dim

The number of specified terms.

label

A character string representing the full call for the random effect model.

Details

The function constructs a list that includes the specified terms for the random effects. This list can be used as a specification for a random effect model. Several re() calls in a formula are combined, so re(region) + re(province) is the same model as re(region, province).

Note

At least one variable must be provided as input.

Examples

# this function is not intended for use by itself
re(province)
#> $term
#> [1] "province"
#> 
#> $dim
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "re(province)"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "RiskMap_re_spec"

# use in a model formula
data(italy_sim)
fit <- glgpm(
  formula = y ~ gp() + re(province),
  data = italy_sim[1:100,],
  family = "gaussian",
  messages = FALSE
)
